name: chi2inv
expr: x_k1 = chi2inv(ps, 1); x_k5 = chi2inv(ps, 5); x_k30 = chi2inv(ps, 30); x_p0 = chi2inv(0.0, 5); x_p1 = chi2inv(1.0, 5); x_pneg = chi2inv(-0.1, 5); x_pover = chi2inv(1.5, 5); x_kbad = chi2inv(0.5, 0); x_kneg = chi2inv(0.5, -1);
comment: Sig: x = chi2inv(p, k). Inverse Chi² CDF with k dof. Covers k ∈ {1, 5, 30} × p ∈ {0.05, 0.5, 0.95} + p=0 (=> 0) + p=1 (=> Inf) + p outside [0,1] (=> NaN) + k<=0 (=> NaN).
